# Start Forcing Spawn Room

Source: [4450](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4450); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Forcing Spawn Room](../../api/actions/start-forcing-spawn-room.md).

<a id="wiki-4450-n1"></a>

- Forcing spawn room works only on assault, hybrid and payload maps.

<a id="wiki-4450-n2"></a>

- Rooms are zero-indexed; nonexistent room falls back to normal spawn room.
